Name: Decoratable Cabins Rework
Author: AkiAkumu
Description:
[center][b][size=5]⋆ Decoratable Cabins: Reworked ⋆[/size]
[/b][/center]﻿

Tired of the same old cabins? Want to give your multiplayer friends something new and fully immersive? This mod introduces [b][i]7 brand-new standalone cabins[/i][/b] that are fully decoratable, paintable, and compatible with seasonal visuals via Elle’s Seasonal Vanilla Buildings. Each cabin also features unique interior upgrades from Base - 1st Upgrade - Final Upgrade!

[center][size=5][b]⋆ Features ⋆
[/b][/size][/center][list]
[*][b]7 Unique Cabins:[/b]
Add Plank, Log, Beach, Neighbor, Rustic, Trailer, and Farmhouse-style cabins to your farm — perfect for theming your multiplayer spaces or customizing your solo layout.[*][b]Fully Paintable:[/b]
Customize each cabin with the paint tool to match your farm's aesthetic.[*][b]Seasonal Compatibility:[/b]
Each design seamlessly blends into spring, summer, fall, and winter using Elle’s Seasonal Vanilla Buildings as a visual base.[*][b]Complete Interior Support:[/b]
All 7 cabins have interior designs for Base, Upgrade 1, and Upgrade 2, keeping the inside just as stylish and immersive as the outside.[i][b]Note: There are 8 total textures for the cabins, but 1 of them cannot be customized or painted
[/b][/i][*][b]Standalone Buildings:[/b]
These cabins do not replace the original ones. Instead, they are new, independent cabin entries — no conflicts, just more choice.[/list][center][size=5][b]⋆ Compatibility ⋆
[/b]
[/size][/center][list]
[*]✅ Works with Stardew Valley 1.5+
[*]✅ Designed to integrate with Elle’s Seasonal Vanilla Buildings
[*]✅ Compatible with other Content Patcher mods
[/list]
[center][size=3][b]⋆ Credits ⋆
[/b]Special thanks to Abagaianye and Irocendar for being a mod tech support in the discord channel.[/size][/center]
